summary: verdaccio-tarball-local-storage ships preinstall dropper that fetches Bun runtime and executes obfuscated Bun-only payload
details: The package declares a `preinstall` script (`node setup.mjs`) which, on `npm install`, probes for a system `bun` binary and, if absent, downloads a Bun runtime release from `https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v<version>/...`. It then invokes Bun via `execFileSync` against the sibling file `math_init.js`. That file is a 727KB single-line obfuscated blob carrying a `// @bun @bun-cjs` header, indicating it is compiled for the Bun runtime and is not directly readable as Node source; it uses an obfuscator.io-style string-array rotator (`WV8StW`) over a large mixed constants array (`n7gIxM`) with hex-mangled identifiers. The package's stated purpose is a verdaccio storage plugin fork, which has no need for a Bun runtime — Bun is used to execute an opaque payload under a runtime Node-focused tooling does not inspect. The package name `verdaccio-tarball-local-storage` mimics `@verdaccio/local-storage`, but `package.json.repository` points to `github.com/servicetitan/uikit`, unrelated to the verdaccio project. Installing this package causes the obfuscated Bun payload to run on the installer's host at install time.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
